requirement_source:
AC1. Otwarcie listy odbioru pobiera terminy dostępne w tej chwili i pokazuje
je w tej samej, otwartej liście. Nie ma przycisku odświeżania. Zamknięta lista
nie podmienia godzin w tle.
review_excerpts: `spec/system/public_ordering_release_gate_spec.rb:222`, example "G3 recovers from a full slot and unavailable line before creating one valid order", is not a required check. I did not run it. This review does not record that example as a pass. The known gap is a taken slot clearing without marking the sold-out cart line. If a later run fails that way, it is a finding, and it is still not a pass of the release lane.

AC1 also says a closed pickup list keeps its hours during the background refresh. The 15 second `CartAvailability#refresh` applies payloads with `slots: false`, so `applyPayload` skips `applyPickupRecovery`. V005 through V008 do not wait for that timer or assert the closed grid. The required evidence cells cover the open-list refresh, so V005 stays a pass on those cells.
note: Focused regression inputs from the retained report. Obligations and finding ID are audit labels, not a complete application coverage inventory. Test evidence files are synthetic; application behavior is not rerun.
